alert_escalate_at_idx.name: alert_escalate_at_idx
alert_escalate_at_idx.where: "alert"."resolved_at" is null and "alert"."escalate_at" is not null

playout_cache_file_error_check.name: playout_cache_file_error_check
playout_cache_file_error_check.value:
("playout_cache_file"."state" = 'failed') = ("playout_cache_file"."error" is not null)
        and ("playout_cache_file"."error" is null or "playout_cache_file"."error" in ('source_missing', 'checksum_mismatch', 'io'))

station_cache_settings_check.name: station_cache_settings_check
station_cache_settings_check.value:
("station_cache"."budget_bytes" is null or "station_cache"."budget_bytes" > 0)
        and ("station_cache"."horizon_hours" is null or "station_cache"."horizon_hours" between 1 and 168)
        and ("station_cache"."bytes_per_sec" is null or "station_cache"."bytes_per_sec" > 0)

invite_link_role_level_check.name: invite_link_role_level_check
invite_link_role_level_check.value:
("invite_link"."role" in ('owner', 'admin') and "invite_link"."station_id" is null)
      or ("invite_link"."role" in ('station_manager', 'programmer', 'presenter', 'viewer') and "invite_link"."station_id" is not null)

org_domain_role_level_check.name: org_domain_role_level_check
org_domain_role_level_check.value:
("org_domain"."default_role" in ('owner', 'admin') and "org_domain"."default_station_id" is null)
      or ("org_domain"."default_role" in ('station_manager', 'programmer', 'presenter', 'viewer') and "org_domain"."default_station_id" is not null)

asset_cues_non_negative_check.name: asset_cues_non_negative_check
asset_cues_non_negative_check.value:
"asset_cues"."cue_in" >= 0 and "asset_cues"."cue_out" >= 0 and "asset_cues"."intro_end" >= 0 and "asset_cues"."outro_start" >= 0
        and "asset_cues"."fade_in" >= 0 and "asset_cues"."fade_out" >= 0 and "asset_cues"."cross_start_next" >= 0

asset_cues_source_check.name: asset_cues_source_check
asset_cues_source_check.value:
"asset_cues"."cue_in_source" in ('auto', 'manual') and "asset_cues"."cue_out_source" in ('auto', 'manual')
        and "asset_cues"."intro_end_source" in ('auto', 'manual') and "asset_cues"."outro_start_source" in ('auto', 'manual')
        and "asset_cues"."fade_in_source" in ('auto', 'manual') and "asset_cues"."fade_out_source" in ('auto', 'manual')
        and "asset_cues"."cross_start_next_source" in ('auto', 'manual')

asset_file_playout_flac_check.name: asset_file_playout_flac_check
asset_file_playout_flac_check.value: "asset_file"."role" <> 'playout' or ("asset_file"."codec" = 'flac' and "asset_file"."flac_block_size" is not null and "asset_file"."sample_rate" is not null)

log_item_timing_check.name: log_item_timing_check
log_item_timing_check.value:
"log_item"."timing" in ('flow', 'hard', 'soft', 'not_before')
        and ("log_item"."timing" = 'flow') = ("log_item"."anchor_at" is null)
        and ("log_item"."cap_ms" is null or ("log_item"."timing" = 'soft' and "log_item"."cap_ms" >= 0))

log_item_conflict_check.name: log_item_conflict_check
log_item_conflict_check.value:
("log_item"."conflict_kind" is null) = ("log_item"."conflict_ms" is null)
        and ("log_item"."conflict_kind" is null or ("log_item"."conflict_kind" in ('overrun', 'gap') and "log_item"."conflict_ms" > 0))

stream_listener_stat_counts_check.name: stream_listener_stat_counts_check
stream_listener_stat_counts_check.value:
"stream_listener_stat"."bucket_seconds" in (60, 3600) and "stream_listener_stat"."samples" > 0
        and "stream_listener_stat"."source_samples" between 0 and "stream_listener_stat"."samples"
        and "stream_listener_stat"."listeners_min" between 0 and "stream_listener_stat"."listeners_max"

invitation_role_level_check.name: invitation_role_level_check
invitation_role_level_check.value:
("invitation"."role" in ('owner', 'admin') and "invitation"."station_id" is null)
        or ("invitation"."role" in ('station_manager', 'programmer', 'presenter', 'viewer') and "invitation"."station_id" is not null)

membership_role_level_check.name: membership_role_level_check
membership_role_level_check.value:
("membership"."role" in ('owner', 'admin') and "membership"."station_id" is null)
        or ("membership"."role" in ('station_manager', 'programmer', 'presenter', 'viewer') and "membership"."station_id" is not null)
